title: 第一卷 第326章 我准备拆了南城
slug: 纨绔世子爷公主退婚我造反
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林修查人的事还没来得及有结果。

陈炎这边先把柳巷那间破书院看烦了。

门板新换的，桌子也擦了，墙上还贴着大宁公学四个字。

可这条街还是破。

破得特别理直气壮。

路面坑一块，泥一块。

旁边水沟里还有不知道谁家倒的剩菜叶子，烂得很有个性。

几个孩子蹲在墙角拿树枝写字。

写完一个“人”，旁边一条黄狗路过，抬腿就滋了。

之前我和李天逸交手了一局，我之所以要做得那么过分，就是想要试探出他这个调查组组长到底水平如何。

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

Lin Xiu's investigation of people has not yet come to an end.

Chen Yan was tired of looking at the shabby academy in Liuxiang.

The door panels have been replaced, the tables have been cleaned, and the words Daning Public School are still posted on the wall.

But this street is still broken.

Very confident and confident.

There are potholes and mud on the road.

There are leftover leaves from unknown sources in the ditch next to them. They are rotten in a very unique way.

Several children squatted in the corner and wrote on branches.

After writing about a "person", a yellow dog passed by and raised his leg.

I had a game with Li Tianyi before. The reason why I went so far was to find out how good he was as the leader of the investigation team.
